skill.summary: Upscale an existing HTTPS video via WeryAI (video-upscaler). Use when the user wants higher resolution output, not text-to-video.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the video-tool-upscaler skill

- Upscales existing videos from a public HTTPS URL using the WeryAI service.
- Supports output resolutions: 1080p (default), 2k, or 4k.
- CLI workflow includes dry-run validation, wait/poll, submit, and status commands.
- Requires only WERYAI_API_KEY and Node.js 18+.
- Accepts only public HTTPS media URLs (no local files, no upload flow).
- Documents strict in-scope usage; out-of-scope scripts or features are excluded.
